summary.text: Adam Hinojosa is a Republican member of the Texas Senate representing District 27, which runs along the southern Gulf Coast. He chairs the Senate Committee on Nominations.

paragraphs.text: Hinojosa, a fourth-generation Texan who lives in Corpus Christi, was elected to the Senate in 2024 according to the Senate page, which describes him as the first Republican to represent District 27 since Reconstruction.
He attended Del Mar College, is a CFO and small business owner, and is a police academy graduate.
He lives in Corpus Christi with his wife, Victoria, and their four children.
